Container.Name: chatterbox-voice
Container.Overview:
John's cloned voice for script voiceovers: Chatterbox-Turbo with a LoRA fine-tuned on John's recordings (merged into one T3 file). POST {"input": "text"} to /v1/audio/speech and get a 24 kHz WAV back; /health shows whether the model is loaded.
GPU is shared with llama-swap, so the model loads on the first request (about 20 s) and frees the card after IDLE_UNLOAD_S seconds idle (default 300; 0 keeps it loaded). Needs about 5 GB VRAM. One request at a time.
Model files are not in the image: put base/ (Chatterbox-Turbo files), t3_turbo_finetuned_merged.safetensors and ref.wav in the Models folder. LAN only, no auth.
Container.Requires: Nvidia-Driver plugin; model files in the Models folder.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Holds base/, t3_turbo_finetuned_merged.safetensors, ref.wav (and lora/ as a backup copy).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID (nvidia-smi -L). Default = tower03 RTX 3060 Ti. Tower04 Quadro: use its UUID.

Config.Name: Idle unload (seconds)
Config.Description: Free the GPU after this many idle seconds. 0 = keep the model loaded.

Config.Name: Name temperature
Config.Description: Temperature for sentences that contain John's name (steadier pronunciation).
